name: M2QA
description: M2QA is a multi-domain multilingual question answering benchmark designed to evaluate NLP models' generalization and robustness across different languages and domains. It contains 13,500 SQuAD 2.0-style QA instances in German, Turkish, and Chinese across product reviews, news, and creative writing domains.
reputation: A relatively new multilingual QA benchmark from 2024 that has seen early use in cross-lingual robustness evaluation, but is not yet a widely established community standard.
notes: Focuses on joint adaptation across languages and domains; publicly available dataset.
